ratings_why.fun: Good growth shape: a natural turn-3 Full for early fights, a wind-the-clock midgame, then the Moon-Scour's rising payout; the early Fulls are sparse until you own a turner.
ratings_why.distinct: A visible moon clock you wind in shop and fight, plus Borrow as a doubling layer for other tribes, plays unlike today's six; the payoffs themselves are familiar Hare-wide +X/+X.

verdict_why: Grandam's copies and Waxwell's 'fire twice' against Once a turn don't say how they work, and both sit on the tribe's biggest growth lines.

points.text: Grandam of the Forms: say what stats a copy has (the Hare's base plus the Leveret's gains, or only the Leveret's), and whether copies count towards triples.
Dame Waxwell: say whether 'fire twice' gets past Once a turn (Moon-Scour, Sixpence Doe, Grandam), and how a second Waxwell text borrowed by a Ribboned Jack stacks.
Jill Longshanks: say what the bout does when the slot across is empty.
Waning has only the Dusk Nurse; one Tier 2 or 3 Waning payoff would make the step between Full and New a phase you plan for, not one you skip.
Sister Silverpenny is a blank 4/8 in a mostly-Hare board; a fallback such as 'or your biggest unit if you have no non-Hare' keeps her draftable in the clock build.

standouts.why: Moon-Caller turning the moon mid-fight gives a surprise Full, switching on Moonlit and Borrow while the fight runs.
Ribboned Jack is a cheap, positional doubler at Tier 2 that stays useful into Tier 6 beside a payoff.
The Moon-Scour's counter gives the late game a climbing number you'd want to watch grow.

weakest.why: Moon-Gazer is a 1/2 whose only job is one moon turn when sold; it does little on turns 1 and 2.
Witch in Borrowed Shape's value depends on whatever the enemy across happens to print, often When played text that never fires.
Sister Silverpenny does nothing in a mono-Hare board.

flags.note: With Mother Meikle Care the Full count climbs about two a turn, so the payout grows quadratically; Once a turn caps count, not size.
Grandam copying Grandam or Waxwell feeds triples, and each triple Discovers; a triple every turn is possible with three back-row Leverets.
Waxwell with Meikle Care and two or three moon turns a shop multiplies Ring Referee and the Charmer several times a turn.
Interaction with Once a turn and with a borrowed second copy is not stated.
A copy's stats and whether it counts towards triples are not stated.
Always-on Borrow of another tribe's Tier 6 capstone doubles it from Tier 5.
No rule for an empty slot across.
